assessments.contract: The native opaque generator builds the remote apply branch by downcasting to its exact remote type and cloning that concrete value; ordinary opaque mode clones Self. It reports mismatched types for failed downcast and reports the reflected kind as Opaque. The common generator gives a remote wrapper an Any view of self.0 and its mutable form, not a primitive field; set delegates whole-value extraction to Reflect::take. The opaque FromReflect generator clones a matching concrete remote value into the wrapper.
assessments.first_party_connection: Current ReflectedAnimationElapsed and ReflectedUnitInterval select reflect_remote of the respective checked canonical type and reflect opaque, with transparent Serde. Native remote generation emits a transparent wrapper over pub Remote, so its as_remote_mut and Any mutable view target AnimationElapsed or UnitInterval themselves. Their current underlying f32 fields are private; scalar Serde is explicitly try_from f32 and the current TryFrom implementations call the checked finite/nonnegative or finite/[0,1] constructors.

Opaque clone does not validate an already invalid value produced elsewhere. No native dynamic-value or gameplay execution occurred.

perspectives.invariant-operations: Cloning or replacing a valid checked value is distinct from manufacturing or mutating an invalid one; unsafe or custom clone/default/mutation routes remain open.

perspectives.type-granularity: Opaque and remote wrappers have distinct visibility/Any/clone behavior; accepting a primitive f32 is not equivalent to accepting the checked canonical type.
